verdict.rationale: ADK is a self-hostable framework, so the evidence implies you control where data lives. You can package agents as containers and run them in any environment, run offline or disconnected from Google Cloud, and use locally running models. You can also choose among Google Cloud targets: Agent Runtime, Cloud Run and GKE. However, no evidence explicitly documents region selection or data-residency controls for sessions, artifacts or managed deployments. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency configuration docs for managed deployments (Agent Runtime/Cloud Run), documented storage-location controls for session/artifact data, independent corroboration.
